title: Shipment Tracking and Updates
description: Customers can track their shipment using the tracking number provided via email or SMS after dispatch.

details.how_to_track: Customers can enter the tracking number on our website's 'Track Shipment' page or use the mobile app.
details.update_frequency: Shipment status is updated every 2 hours.
details.support: If tracking information is delayed or incorrect, customers can reach support via email or our 24/7 chat assistant.
details.international_tracking: International shipments may have limited real-time tracking based on the carrier.

title: Delayed Delivery Handling
description: Policy for addressing and compensating customers for delayed deliveries.

details.customer_rights: If a shipment is delayed by more than 48 hours beyond the ETA, the customer is eligible for a service credit.
steps_to_resolve: Track the shipment using the tracking ID.
If status is stuck, reach out to support with tracking number and order details.
If eligible, file a compensation claim from your dashboard under 'Delivery Issues'.

title: Return and Refund Policy
description: Guidelines for initiating returns and obtaining refunds for incorrect, damaged, or delayed shipments.

details.eligibility: Returns must be initiated within 7 days of delivery.
details.refund_processing_time: Refunds will be processed within 5-7 business days after inspection.
details.return_shipping: Free return shipping for damaged or incorrect items. For all other reasons, customer bears return shipping cost.

title: Shipping and Delivery Time Policy
description: Estimated delivery timelines and factors affecting shipping duration.

details.international_delivery: 7–14 business days, subject to customs clearance.
details.priority_shipping: Available for select locations at additional cost.

title: Lost or Missing Package Policy
description: What to do if your shipment is marked as delivered but is missing or suspected to be lost.

steps_to_follow: Confirm the delivery address and check with neighbors.
Wait 24 hours as some carriers mark deliveries in advance.
Contact customer support with order ID and tracking number.
details.investigation_duration: Investigation can take up to 7 business days.

title: Payment and Billing Policy
description: Details about supported payment methods, billing cycles, and issues with transactions.

details.billing_support: Invoices are generated automatically and can be downloaded from the customer dashboard.
details.payment_issues: In case of failed payments, amount is typically reversed within 3–5 business days.
details.late_payments: For business accounts, late payments beyond 15 days will incur a late fee.

title: Packaging and Handling Policy
description: Standard procedures for packaging, labeling, and handling of goods to ensure safe delivery.

details.material_standards: All parcels are packed using tamper-proof, weather-resistant packaging.
details.fragile_items: Labeled as FRAGILE and double-cushioned during transit.
details.bulk_orders: May be split into multiple packages based on weight and volume restrictions.
details.sustainability_note: Our packaging uses 80% recyclable materials to reduce environmental impact.
